key_findings: Paclitaxel activated S1 cortical astrocytes but not spinal astrocytes/microglia or S1 microglia; gliotoxin LAAA in S1 abolished PCX-induced mechanical allodynia.
Goshajinkigan suppressed PCX-induced S1 astrocyte activation and reduced mechanical allodynia (~50%) and thermal hyperalgesia (~90%).
